business_problem: rKube needed to accelerate Java modernization for customers because manual refactoring of enterprise WebSphere applications was slow, costly, and difficult to validate across outdated codebases and tests.
solution_summary: rKube worked with IBM Client Engineering on a six-week proof of concept using IBM watsonx Code Assistant to automate key steps in enterprise Java modernization. The assistant was inserted directly into rKube's workflow so teams could generate transformation-ready code changes, produce unit tests, and review explanatory summaries of what had changed. Because the product is tuned specifically for modernization, the team used it to convert traditional IBM WebSphere application code toward IBM WebSphere Liberty targets while preserving quality controls. The PoC also emphasized transparency, with summarized explanations that helped teams validate the automated changes before moving on. By turning application analysis, transformation, and testing into a more integrated workflow, rKube reduced the manual bottlenecks that typically slow modernization programs and created a faster path for taking customer Java estates into more contemporary frameworks.
